subject: Post-call recap: Redwood Inference & NovaCorp — Exec recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novacorp.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood Inference & NovaCorp — Exec recap and next steps

Hi Daniel / Samantha —

Thanks for taking the time today — great conversation and appreciate the executive context. Below is a short executive-friendly recap of what we heard, the business outcomes you emphasized, the main risks to address for procurement, and clear next steps. I flagged items where we’ll loop in the team.

Summary of the call (for execs):
- Business outcome: Reduce customer support response time and triage costs by automating intent classification and routing for support tickets; target 30-40% reduction in average handle time within the first 6 months.
- Key metrics you care about: MTT (mean time to triage), agent handoff rate, and cost per ticket.
- Current pain points: high latency on batch inference for nightly processing; inconsistent embeddings between environments; difficulty meeting PII/data residency requirements for EU customers.

Technical risks & procurement blockers (what procurement/security will ask):
1) SOC 2 / security evidence — you asked for our latest attestation and a short summary of data handling. (Attaching SOC2 attestation; will follow up with a brief write-up for your InfoSec doc.)
2) Data residency & isolation — NovaCorp needs VPC/private deployment options for EU processing.
3) SLA/Uptime and escalation paths — procurement will request clear SLAs and an operational runbook for outages.
4) Pricing model concerns — you’d like clarity on committed capacity vs burst pricing for the deduction of peak nightly jobs.

Proposed pilot & success criteria:
- 8-week pilot (Dedicated pool) processing your nightly enrichment pipeline + live secondary routing for 10% of support traffic.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in mean triage time for pilot traffic, stable latency under 400ms p95 for live routing, and <1% model-quality regressions vs baseline.

Next steps (owners & timing):
- Redwood: Share proposal and SOW draft for pilot + SOC2 attestation (attached). — Marissa (EOD today) [Attachment: Redwood-Proposal-NovaCorp-20270615.pdf]
- Red: Technical deep-dive for data residency options + example architecture for VPC/private deployment. — Aditya (by Thu, 6/17)
- NovaCorp: Confirm procurement timeline and point of contact for contract redlines. — Daniel / Procurement (by Fri, 6/18)
- Schedule 30-min exec sync to confirm pilot success metrics and procurement path. — Proposed: Mon 6/21 10:00 PT (I’ll send an invite)

Open items for execs: please confirm the procurement contact (email) and whether a POC/PO is required before legal signs. If you prefer, we can do a short 1-pager for your CFO on expected TCO improvements vs current infra.

Thanks again — looking forward to partnering.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood Inference & NovaCorp — Exec recap and next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- Procurement: Procurement lead is Elena Torres (elena.torres@novacorp.com). We target a decision by the end of July but procurement needs the SOW and security artifacts to start the review this week.
- SOC2: Thanks for the attestation — can you also send a short narrative on data handling and retention (how long token logs are kept, redaction policies)?
- Pricing: We’re sensitive to the nightly batch cost spike; want to see committed capacity options with guaranteed cost ceilings.
- EU data: We will need a VPC/private deployment for EU customers. Legal might require a clause for data residency in the MSA.

I’ve looped procurement on this thread. Let’s get the SOW in and we’ll set a procurement review next week. Also looping in our VP of Ops (Samantha) to confirm the KPIs.

Thanks,
Daniel
VP Product, NovaCorp
